answer: Require every agent to lock a pearl-sized bond of scarce stake before it can earn, slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. A willow-like reputation tree then grows only from verified work: each new identity starts at zero and must complete costly, audited tasks before its votes count. Old work cannot be faked or bought — a relic of real history stays on-ledger — so spawning a thousand sybils means funding a thousand bonds and a thousand work histories, and the attack costs more than the reward it could steal.
